calls.title: Ashley Stirrup and Leah Thompson
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted integration challenges between Growth Book and Customer IO, particularly concerning API errors and user data structure that hinder user syncing. Graham McNicoll pointed out specific errors related to the MongoDB trigger and the Identify call in Customer IO, while Leah Thompson suggested involving Customer IO's tech support for a detailed investigation. Additionally, there were issues regarding updates that overwrite existing user profiles, prompting a discussion on proper API structuring. The team also explored the implications of adding company objects for better targeting and segmentation, as Growth Book had recently onboarded a significant number of organizations. Lastly, they discussed enhancing user engagement through personalized messaging strategies, including in-app messages, and planned next steps for further collaboration and support.
calls.keywords: Customer IO, MongoDB triggers, Identify API error, onboarding campaigns, user segmentation, in-app messaging
